The new tokens are target-only +1 bdnz +1 mtctr and ours-only -1 addic. -1 bne: this target lowers its checksum loop to a CTR loop and OUR BASELINE ALREADY MATCHED IT. The two sibling functions want OPPOSITE loop forms from identical-looking C - writeGauntletSave's target wants the fused addic. guard, loadGauntletSave's target wants mtctr/bdnz - so the carrier is emphatically not transferable between them, and this is the cheapest possible demonstration that the premise was wrong.
